sections.heading: ACM INTRODUCTION
sections.content:
The Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) is the world’s largest educational and scientific computing society, bringing together educators, researchers, and professionals to inspire dialogue, share resources, and address the field’s challenges.
ACM supports professional growth through:
- Technical Conferences
- Digital Library
- Workshops
- Webinars
- Publications
- Coding Competitions
- Career Development
- Networking Opportunities

sections.heading: About APCOER ACM Student Chapter
sections.content:
The ACM Student Chapter at Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research (APCOER) is established to promote technical excellence, innovation, research, and professional development among students.
Our chapter provides a platform where students can learn emerging technologies, collaborate on projects, participate in competitions, interact with industry experts, and contribute to the computing community.
The chapter welcomes students from all engineering disciplines who have an interest in computing and technology.

### ACM INTRODUCTION
The Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) is the world’s largest educational and scientific computing society, bringing together educators, researchers, and professionals to inspire dialogue, share resources, and address the field’s challenges.
ACM supports professional growth through:
- Technical Conferences
- Digital Library
- Workshops
- Webinars
- Publications
- Coding Competitions
- Career Development
- Networking Opportunities

### About APCOER ACM Student Chapter
The ACM Student Chapter at Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research (APCOER) is established to promote technical excellence, innovation, research, and professional development among students.
Our chapter provides a platform where students can learn emerging technologies, collaborate on projects, participate in competitions, interact with industry experts, and contribute to the computing community.
The chapter welcomes students from all engineering disciplines who have an interest in computing and technology.
